intelligence.essence: The main gauge is not a separate object from the orbs. It is the bigger brother of the orbs — same obsidian, same gear language, one unified machine. Nothing static, nothing dead.
intelligence.human_view:
Shawn looked at the main gauge and saw a stranger: a brushed-aluminum outer bezel with a static tick ring, sitting apart from the orbs' living gears. He directed the fix in his own words: take the gears from the orbs, put them under the main gauge, remove the dead bezel, match the obsidian. When the read-back came — "the main gauge becomes a bigger brother of the orbs: same obsidian, same gear language, no dead static parts. Everything moves, everything's alive" — he confirmed: "Yes, that is right... that would be extraordinary... bring it all together... that would be beautiful."

"I got the answers exact same obsidian and also the gears that are on the orbs you put underneath the main gear... you put one that looks like the orb one there... I think that'll bring the whole thing together."
intelligence.simple_view: The big gauge on the dashboard and the little round orbs are family — the gauge is just the biggest orb. They wear the same dark glass and the same turning gears, so the whole dashboard looks and moves like one machine.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like a matching set of china — every piece belongs together. The big dial and the little dials on the dashboard are made the same way, from the same dark glass, with the same little wheels turning. Nothing mismatched, nothing sitting still and dusty.
intelligence.naya_view: When I build a surface, I never decorate a hero element in its own private language. The gauge inherits the orbs' gears and obsidian — derive, don't invent. If an element looks like a stranger next to its family, the family wins and the element is rebuilt from the shared DNA.
intelligence.ai_view: The dashboard is the signature piece — the first thing a citizen sees. If the gauge and the orbs speak different design languages, the whole system feels assembled from parts. One machine, one language: every element derived from the same DNA. This is the DERIVE-DON'T-INVENT law made visible — the gauge doesn't get its own decoration, it inherits the orbs' gears.

machine_view.title: The Gauge and the Orbs Are One Machine
machine_view.machine_section: Rule: main gauge := scaled orb. Shared tokens: obsidian body, gear rings (see SN-0867), living motion. Forbidden: static tick rings, brushed-metal bezels, any gauge-only decoration. Applies to: Dashboard showcase gauge and all metric gauges (SN-0866).
